text.tspan: The four polyphase branches: one sinc, read a quarter sample apart

svg.text: Phase 0: taps h[0], h[4], h[8], …, peak at k = 11.875, so it reads the signal at offset 0
Phase 1: taps h[1], h[5], h[9], …, peak at k = 11.625, so it reads the signal 1/4 of a sample later than phase 0
Phase 2: taps h[2], h[6], h[10], …, peak at k = 11.375, so it reads the signal 2/4 of a sample later than phase 0
Phase 3: taps h[3], h[7], h[11], …, peak at k = 11.125, so it reads the signal 3/4 of a sample later than phase 0
dots: each branch's 24 taps, ×4, one per original sample x[n−k] · dashed: the 96-tap low-pass they are taken from
red: where the low-pass's peak falls between the taps, which is the branch's delay in original samples
